PRIORITY: P0
MODE: EXECUTE, TEST, COMMIT, PUSH, DEPLOY, VERIFY
DO NOT RETURN ANOTHER DIAGNOSTIC-ONLY REPORT

CURRENT ISSUE

IVX IA has already diagnosed the chat loading bug multiple times.

Do not diagnose it again.

The missing work is:

- edit the real owner-controlled source
- run tests
- fix failures
- create a commit
- push to GitHub
- run CI
- deploy
- verify production
- return evidence

OWNER CONTROL REQUIREMENT

Use only:

- Owner GitHub repository:
  ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform

- Owner Render service:
  srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0

- Owner-controlled credentials and deployment pipeline

Do not create sandbox-only code.
Do not leave valid changes only inside the Rork workspace.

STEP 1 — VERIFY EXECUTION ACCESS

Before editing, verify:

- GitHub write access
- branch creation
- commit
- push
- PR creation
- GitHub Actions
- Render deploy
- deployment status read access

Return:

- capability
- PASS/FAIL
- exact HTTP status if failed
- exact missing permission
- trace ID

If this Rork session cannot execute, move the task into an execution-capable Rork workspace/session. Do not repeat analysis.

STEP 2 — CREATE BRANCH

Create:

fix/ivx-chat-loading-final

Record:

- starting GitHub main SHA
- branch creation proof
- clean working tree status

STEP 3 — APPLY THE REAL FIX

Update the relevant files, including as applicable:

- expo/app/ivx/chat.tsx
- expo/src/modules/ivx-owner-ai/services/ivxChatService.ts
- expo/src/modules/ivx-owner-ai/services/ivxAIRequestService.ts
- expo/src/modules/chat/services/ivxSendTriggerPolicy.ts
- related tests

Required behavior:

1. Immediate cached shell before network completion
2. Skeleton loading state
3. Parallel independent data loading
4. No duplicate bootstrap calls
5. Cached schema/table resolution
6. Non-blocking AI health probe
7. 8-second timeout
8. Local fallback on timeout/failure
9. One realtime subscription only
10. No duplicate messages
11. Session persistence after restart
12. Correct owner routing
13. Correct engineering-intent routing
14. No property query for engineering questions

STEP 4 — ADD TESTS

Add tests for:

- cached shell renders immediately
- skeleton renders
- timeout fallback
- network failure fallback
- one bootstrap call
- one realtime subscription
- no duplicate messages
- session persistence
- English engineering prompts
- Spanish engineering prompts

STEP 5 — RUN TESTS

Run:

- focused chat tests
- routing tests
- conversation-state tests
- backend TypeScript
- Expo TypeScript
- Expo lint
- relevant backend tests
- relevant Expo tests
- secret scan

Required:

- TypeScript: 0 errors
- critical lint errors: 0
- focused tests: PASS
- no unexplained failures

Fix failures and rerun until clean.

STEP 6 — COMMIT AND PUSH

Commit:

Push to owner GitHub.

Return:

- files changed
- tests added
- test totals
- commit SHA
- remote SHA
- branch URL
- PR URL

STEP 7 — CI

Trigger GitHub Actions.

Wait for completion.

If CI fails:

- identify root cause
- fix
- commit
- push
- rerun

Return:

- CI run ID
- checks
- PASS/FAIL
- final tested SHA

STEP 8 — DEPLOY

After CI passes:

1. Merge into main
2. Deploy Render
3. Record deployment ID
4. Verify:
   - /health
   - /version
   - IVX IA status
   - worker status

Required equality:

GitHub main SHA
=
CI tested SHA
=
Render deployed SHA
=
runtime /health SHA
=
runtime /version SHA

STEP 9 — REAL DEVICE QA

Test on a physical Android device:

- cold start
- warm start
- owner login
- chat opens without blank screen
- cached shell appears immediately
- history loads
- realtime works
- no duplicate messages
- session persists
- weak network fallback
- no crash
- no infinite loading

Return:

- device model
- Android version
- app version
- source SHA
- PASS/FAIL per test
- screenshots/logs
- trace IDs

FINAL EVIDENCE

Return only:

- Job ID
- Starting SHA
- Final SHA
- Branch
- Commit SHA
- Remote SHA
- CI run ID
- Render deployment ID
- Runtime SHA
- Test results
- Device QA result
- Remaining issues
- Final status

Do not return “diagnosis complete.”
Do not return “fix proposed.”
Do not return “pending.”

Allowed final statuses:

- VERIFIED
- BLOCKED_EXTERNAL
- FAILED
